metadata.name: Keelhaven
metadata.description:
Oroth II, "Keelhaven", is the subsector's naval depot, 600,000 km out from the gas giant Oroth. An Imperial strike force has jumped in to take it: the Wind-class carrier Sirocco and her eighty light fighters, two Valiant light cruisers and six escorts, coming in from the jump limit 100,000 km out and under way. Keelhaven is held by the Hadrian-class battle rider Cleon, the planetoid monitor Keelhaven Bastion and eighty heavy fighters, while twenty-five system defence boats lie dark at the outer moon Oroth V.

Red holds Keelhaven for 30 rounds; Blue must break the defence. Capital ships, spinal mounts and 166 hulls.

ships.name: Cleon
ships.orders: Flagship of the Oroth squadron and the missile wall. Hold Keelhaven: break the enemy capitals with massed missile bays and the meson spinal, and do not be drawn away from the moon.

ships.name: Keelhaven Bastion
ships.orders: The depot's monitor. Stay at Keelhaven and kill whatever comes within reach of the spinal and the barbettes.
